Trimmed markup of QUAlibrate's web UI, as measured in a real browser, for
tests/qb_proxy_selfcheck.cjs and tests/test_qualibrate_proxy.py. Class names
are QUAlibrate's own; run names and paths are synthetic.
  v1_5_1_*  QUAlibrate 1.5.1 (readable CSS-module classes, History cards)
  v2_0_0_*  QUAlibrate 2.0.0 (hashed CSS-module classes, runs table)
